events.event_name: New York Transit Museum Bus Festival
events.brand: New York Transit Museum × MTA New York City Transit
events.address: Emily Warren Roebling Plaza, Brooklyn Bridge Park, Brooklyn, NY 11201
events.what_it_is: A free outdoor festival with vintage NYC buses to board and explore, all-ages activities, transit staff and photo opportunities.
events.what_is_free: Festival admission, vintage bus displays and public activities are free.
events.caveats: Advance registration is encouraged but explicitly not required. The official registration page says tickets are not required for admission. Event runs rain or shine; equipment is subject to change.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–3:30 PM at Emily Warren Roebling Plaza in Brooklyn Bridge Park. Vintage buses close for boarding at 3:30 PM.

events.address: Empire Fulton Ferry Lawn, Brooklyn Bridge Park, Brooklyn, NY 11201
events.what_it_is: A free hands-on basket-weaving workshop using plant materials collected from Brooklyn Bridge Park, intended for ages 12+ but open to all.
events.what_is_free: Workshop participation and materials are free.
events.caveats: The official page provides a free registration link. Materials are available on a first-come, first-served basis, so an RSVP does not establish that materials will remain available on arrival.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–12 PM on Empire Fulton Ferry Lawn. Mostly flat grass setting; seating is on cushions with a limited number of short stools.

events.address: Pier 6 Plaza, Brooklyn Bridge Park, Brooklyn, NY 11201
events.what_it_is: The final Papi Juice waterfront dance party of the season, with Papi Juice, Public Service and Nídia DJing at Pier 6 Plaza.
events.what_is_free: Admission to the dance party is free; food and beverages are available for purchase.
events.caveats: Brooklyn Bridge Park labels the event free and provides a registration link. The source does not establish organizer approval or invitation-only access. No outside alcohol; pets are not permitted.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 4–10 PM at Pier 6 Plaza. Guests may bring food and non-alcoholic drinks; no glass or outside alcohol.

events.address: Pier 3 Central Lawn, Brooklyn Bridge Park, Brooklyn, NY 11201
events.what_it_is: A free all-level one-hour waterfront yoga class led by Abhaya Yoga.
events.what_is_free: Class participation is free; an extremely limited number of yoga mats may be borrowed.
events.caveats: Advance registration is highly encouraged, but the official page explicitly welcomes walk-ups as capacity allows. A fitness waiver is mandatory for every participant; people without a completed waiver cannot join.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 9:30–10:30 AM at Pier 3 Central Lawn. Bring a mat or towel if possible. Walk-ups check in with park staff and must complete the waiver.

events.brand: NYC Emergency Management × Staten Island Children's Museum
events.address: Staten Island Children's Museum, 1000 Richmond Terrace, Building M, Staten Island, NY 10301

subway.station: St. George Ferry Terminal + local bus

events.what_it_is: A family preparedness day with NYC agency and community resources plus children's activities including face painting, a bounce house and balloon art.
events.what_is_free: Museum admission and the preparedness-day activities are free.
events.caveats: NYC Emergency Management lists the event as an in-person public event and states museum admission is free. No advance RSVP requirement is published on the official listing.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 11 AM–3 PM at the Staten Island Children's Museum, 1000 Richmond Terrace, Building M.
